candidates.explanation: The refresh token is signed with expiresIn set to 'auth.expires' (the short access-token lifetime) instead of 'auth.refreshExpires' (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN). As a result the refresh token's exp is only minutes after iat, and /auth/refresh returns 401 once the access-token lifetime has passed. The 30d setting is never used.

fix.description: Use the refresh expiry config when signing the refresh token: change auth.expires to auth.refreshExpires in the second signAsync call.
